prediction_text: Prediction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election — the Costa Mesa ISAR panel consensus read: Clinton defeats Donald Trump on 8 November 2016. Basis of the call as framed in October 2016: polls, incumbency-party continuity configurations and the panel's majority chart reads converge on Clinton; Trump is read as the disruptive loser. This is a single-point call (Clinton), confidence moderate (0.55) given the closeness signalled by the need for a panel split.
